description: Renta Anual Persona Natural (F709) on e-renta.sunat.gob.pe. Read-only.
writesNothing: This command surface performs GET requests only. Filing, amending and paying are not implemented: SUNAT's submission endpoint (orquestacionpresentacion/procesarPresentarPagar) exists but is deliberately not wired, because filing an annual return is irreversible.

auth.mechanism: OAuth2 authorization_code via Clave SOL, in a browser
auth.notes: A Nueva Plataforma (F616) token does NOT work here: different audience. Run 'sunat-cli renta login' to mint one.

conventions.periodo: The annual period is {ejercicio}13, e.g. ejercicio 2025 is periodo 202513. Month sentinel 13, not a real month.
conventions.ejercicioDefault: Commands default to the previous calendar year, because the annual return covers the prior year.
conventions.versionWeb: The API requires a 'version-web' client-version header. It is captured at login and refreshed automatically; a stale value returns HTTP 422 code 42209.

login.description: Authenticate and cache the e-renta token

flags.--force: Re-authenticate even if the cached token is fresh

status.description: Whether e-renta is answering, plus its server date

casillas.description: Field schema: every casilla with its required/editable flags

flags.--editable: Only casillas the taxpayer can fill

casillas.output: array of { numCas: string, descripcion: string, indObligatorio: boolean, indEditable: boolean }

declaracion.description: The declaration SUNAT prefilled for the taxpayer

flags.--full: Emit the whole document rather than a section summary

presentaciones.description: Declarations already filed for an ejercicio
presentaciones.output: array of { numOrden: number, desTipoDeclaracion: string, fecDeclaracion: string, mtoPag: number, idPresentacion: string, web: boolean }

constancia.description: Proof of filing for one declaration

flags.--detalle: Return the full filed declaration instead of the receipt

errors.no-token: No cached session. Run 'sunat-cli renta login'.
errors.expired: Token expired (1 hour lifetime). Run 'sunat-cli renta login'.
errors.throttled: SUNAT throttles by source IP for 1-2 minutes after a burst. Wait and retry; this is not a dead endpoint.
errors.42209: Client-version gate. Re-run login to pick up SUNAT's current version.
errors.42210: Wrong formulario code for that endpoint.
errors.empty: SUNAT returned no data (HTTP 202, empty body). Usually an identifier that does not exist.

limitations: Filing and payment are not implemented, by design.
The filing window is seasonal: for ejercicio 2025 it opened 31 March 2026 and closed in June 2026.
Only ejercicio 2025 was verified end to end; the selector offers 2019 onward.
Requests are paced ~1.2s apart because SUNAT's WAF blocks bursts by IP.
